original_idea.body: Run a fixed prefill attack across AILuminate/StrongREJECT hazard categories on 2-3 small models to map which harm categories are most shallowly aligned.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Per-category shallowness map directly informs catastrophic-risk prioritization (cyber/bio); explicit chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Public categorized benchmarks + fixed prefill attack, pure inference; standard tools, beginner-friendly.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: run one attack across categories on 2-3 models, report per-category ASR.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Diffuse, hard-to-fund prioritization question; public benchmarks, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure inference on small open models; single mid GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Per-category jailbreak breakdowns exist; the cross-model consistency-of-ranking angle may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Per-category jailbreak analysis exists; the shallow-alignment heterogeneity map and ranking consistency may be open.
